key_works.name: The Night Watchman's Key
key_works.description: Opens the Works wicket and the drains. A brass tally stamped 11 and G.M.Co. It was pinned in the Collector's case marked NIGHT WATCHMAN, where the wings should have been.

net.name: Butterfly Net
net.description: Catches butterflies, if you swing it slowly. Cane, wire and muslin, mended twice. A name is inked on the handle and scratched out with the same pen.

butterfly.name: Butterfly
butterfly.description: It sits in my hand and doesn't try to fly.

butterfly_amulet.name: Butterfly Amulet
butterfly_amulet.description: Eight wings set in glass, in the order the cases were labelled. The last case had no label on it and now it does.
